items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I could put as many little dots on the page as I liked. I started writing and then, certain musicians, the people that played my music and asked me for tunes were George Russell, Jimmy Giuffre, Art Farmer, Tony Williams, Steve Kuhn...

ctx.x: And did he say “don’t make it too hard?” I’m just kidding. [Laughs]

My father said... no my father luckily was not there. I could put as many little dots on the page as I liked. I started writing and then, certain musicians, the people that played my music and asked me for tunes were George Russell, Jimmy Giuffre, Art Farmer, Tony Williams, Steve Kuhn, who had just come to town, and he’s still playing some of my
tunes. Who else, who else, that’s all.
